headline: Google ties AI investment to search growth amid earnings
summary: Alphabet says AI investment is driving growth in search queries, including commercial ones, as part of its Q3 2026 earnings, which showed revenue up 25 percent to $127.6 billion. Google is also expanding AI Search ads globally. Coverage differs on whether to emphasize query growth or slowing core ad growth.
